run_evaluate_clip_model: run the evaluate function to compute image and caption selection accuracy on Winoground or SugarCrepe datasets
test_evaluate_function: test the evaluate function with a CLIP-like model, dataloader, and tokenizer to get accuracy metrics
build_image_text_matching: build a CLIP model evaluation pipeline that matches images to captions using cosine similarity embeddings
refactor_evaluate_amp: refactor the evaluate function to toggle automatic mixed precision for faster GPU inference
summarize_evaluate_metrics: summarize the evaluate function which returns image_acc, text_acc, and overall acc metrics from image-caption matching
